figurative_meaning_en: Onomatopoeic word; harsh or grating sound
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার গলা খনখনে হয়ে গেছে, গান গাওয়া কঠিন হচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His voice has become raspy, making it hard to sing.
The door opened with a grating creak.
note: This is primarily an onomatopoeic expression used in everyday Bengali to mimic rough or hoarse sounds.
